Rank 2 Ki Technique

  • Ki Cost: 20 Ki
  • Prerequisites: None
  • Casting Time: 1 Action
  • Range: 90 feet (15 foot radius)
  • Chargeable?: Yes
  • Duration: Instantaneous
  • Type: Barrage

Fire a single energy beam into the air that explodes and rains down a a barrage of ki bullets down in the area.

Choose a point within range, all creatures of your choice in a 15 foot radius must make a Dexterity Saving Throw or take 3d8 Ki Damage on a fail, half on a success.
